metadata.question: What does the IFPI report say about streaming fraud?

response.summary: The IFPI Global Music Report 2026 highlights streaming fraud as a significant threat to the music industry. It describes streaming fraud as the act of artificially generating plays for manipulated or fake content, which diverts vital revenues away from legitimate artists, songwriters, record labels, and others in the music economy. The report notes that 85% of all streams on AI-generated music were fraudulent in 2025, an increase from 70% the previous year. This type of fraud is considered a new form of piracy and is more damaging than many realize. The report emphasizes the need for the entire music community to come together to tackle this issue effectively (Source 1: IFPI Global Music Report 2026, p.24; Source 2: IFPI Global Music Report 2026, p.23; Source 4: IFPI Global Music Report 2026, p.24).
